items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Luke Skiro? If you call his name, I couldn't call him.

ctx.x: Well, I see. Raymond Burke? It could have been him. Luke Skiro? If you call his name, I couldn't call him. What did he look like? Luke Skiro. Luke Skiro. Did he have a mustache? Skiro, Skiro. Uh, yes. It's probably Raymond Burke. And so, he says, uh, Julius, I said, uh, he said, what's your name? I said, Julius Handic. You have to be a hand. He says, you was the honest banjo player. He said, that's just, he said, you make me play. I said, oh, go ahead. He said, yeah, you do. He said, you hold that time. He said,…
Oh, but so easy. You know, out of mind, out of sight, out of mind. That's awfully true.
